en.headline: Hong Kong women's epee team reach Asian Games last eight
en.dek: The team beat Thailand 45-27 in the last 16 in Nagoya on Friday and will next face Kazakhstan for a place in the semi-finals.
body: Hong Kong's women's epee team reached the quarter-finals of the Asian Games in Nagoya on Friday, beating Thailand 45-27 in the last 16, RTHK reported.
Chan Wai-ling, Ng Hoi-tai, Shek Sin-yan and Chu Ka-mong took turns on the piste. Hong Kong led 20-11 after the fourth bout and kept the gap, finishing 18 points clear.

The team will next meet Kazakhstan for a place in the semi-finals. The result comes a day after Fong Kai-shen took bronze in the men's individual epee, and on the same morning the men's foil team beat India to reach the last eight.
Hong Kong had already collected 23 medals at these Games after Thursday's programme, sitting eighth on the table with four golds, 10 silvers and nine bronzes.

zh.headline: 港隊女重團體淘汰泰國 亞運闖八強
zh.dek: 陳渭泠、吳海諦、佘繕妡及朱嘉望周五在名古屋以45：27擊敗泰國，十六強過關後下一場對哈薩克。
body: 亞運劍擊女子重劍團體賽，港隊周五在名古屋十六強以45：27擊敗泰國，晉級八強，港台報道。
港隊由陳渭泠、吳海諦、佘繕妡及朱嘉望先後上陣，第四節完已領先至20：11，其後保持優勢，最終贏18分。
港隊下一場將與哈薩克爭入準決賽。方凱申周四剛在男子重劍個人賽奪銅，同日上午男花團體亦淘汰印度晉級八強。
截至周四賽事結束，港隊今屆亞運累積4金10銀9銅共23面獎牌，暫排獎牌榜第八。
